fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects potential CommandLine obfuscation using unicode characters.
Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or file difficult to discover or analyze by encrypting, encoding, or otherwise obfuscating its contents on the system or in transit.
fields.name: Potential CommandLine Obfuscation Using Unicode Characters
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "ˣ" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "˪" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "ˢ" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "∕" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "⁄" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "―" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "—" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "¯" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "®" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "¶"))
